## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues if applicable.

## Verification

Describe relevant static checks and interactive observations, or explain what remains unverified. Mention material development data resets or retained resources when applicable.

Use a Conventional Commit title and explain any breaking changes. Independent review is optional. Release publication and deployment require a separate explicit manual dispatch; pushes and pull requests must not publish automatically. No automated application tests or saved journeys.
